text: M18's L12 slice (2.1.28) lists `entity-list-header` and `empty-state` among the components consumed and declares no host-local component (the "Host-local components — brak" bullet was dropped; under l12slice0 an absent field means no departures). `TagsList` still draws its own page header (Tag icon + "Tags" heading + "N tags" counter) and its own empty box ("No tags yet." / "Tags auto-create when you add them to an endpoint.") instead of EntityListHeader and EmptyState. The unit's goal names only the tag row and the inline edit, and swapping the header/empty state would change what the user sees, so they are left as they are. Needs: either a follow-up unit recomposing the header and empty state from the catalog, or a Host-local entry (DŁUG) in xfkinig4 naming them.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-2811 — the /tags page header and empty state stay bespoke markup in this window; only the row and the inline edit are catalog-composed.
